svg.aria-label: Total order broadcast with a sequencer: One process decides the order; everybody delivers in that order and no other.. ⟨DATA, m⟩ to everybody, including the sequencer; assign the next sequence number; ⟨ORDER, n, m⟩ to everybody; deliver n only after n − 1; the sequencer crashes: nothing is ordered any more. The order is whatever the sequencer saw: cheap, total, and dependent on a single process.
